title: Fanatics buys regulated exchange in bid to grow prediction markets business
summary: Title: Fanatics buys regulated exchange in bid to grow prediction markets business URL Source: https://www.coindesk.com/markets/2026/07/27/fanatics-buys-regulated-exchange-in-bid-to-grow-prediction-markets-business Published Time: 2026-07-27T14:46:10.332Z Markdown Content: Summary * Fanatics will acquire BGC's federally regulated exchange and clearinghouse to launch and settle its own prediction markets. * The deal positions Fanatics to compete in the fast-growing prediction market sector alongside Kalshi, Polymarket and other emerging platforms. * Fanatics and BGC also plan to develop new market data products that combine prediction market activity with traditional financial market data. American sports company Fanatics is making a major move into prediction markets, a corner of finance that has exploded in popularity over the past year as traders wager on everything from elections to inflation and sports. On Monday, the sports merchandiser [announced](https://www.globenewswire.com/news-release/2026/07/27/3333493/0/en/fanatics-to-acquire-exchange-and-clearinghouse-from-bgc-parties-to-partner-on-prediction-markets.html) that it has agreed to acquire Water Street Labs and CX Clearinghouse from BGC Group, giving Fanatics ownership of a federally regulated exchange and clearinghouse which allows it to launch and settle its own prediction market contracts. Financial terms were not disclosed. Through the acquisition, Fanatics will be able to list and clear contracts itself, giving it more control over the products it offers and how quickly it can bring new markets online. Fanatics and BGC also plan to develop new market data products that combine prediction market activity with traditional financial data, the companies said. Prediction markets have become one of the fastest-growing areas of finance with much of that growth being fueled by CFTC-regulated exchange Kalshi and powerhouse Polymarket, which runs its operations on a blockchain. summary: Title: Lido starts historic $16 billion migration to optimize Ethereum performance URL Source: https://www.coindesk.com/tech/2026/07/27/lido-begins-moving-usd16-5-billion-in-staked-ether-to-cut-validator-count-by-a-third Published Time: 2026-07-27T14:00:00.000Z Markdown Content: Jul 27, 2026, 2:00 p.m. 2 min read ![Image 1: Lido's CMV2 Upgrade (Lido/Media)](https://www.coindesk.com/_next/image?url=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.sanity.io%2Fimages%2Fs3y3vcno%2Fproduction%2F6334f8835e037221b298cb9aea44cd8f5b69ddc0-1920x1080.png%3Fauto%3Dformat&w=3840&q=75) Lido’s new upgrade consolidates more than 8 million staked ether onto an optimized backend architecture to lighten the load across the entire Ethereum network. (Lido/Media) Summary * Lido began its largest upgrade since 2023, consolidating more than 8 million staked ether onto Ethereum’s new post-Pectra validator design. * The shift is expected to cut Ethereum’s total validator count by about one-third and reduce attestation messages by roughly 29% per epoch, easing load on the consensus layer without directly affecting gas fees or transaction speeds. * Lido’s curated node operators are moving to Curated Module v2, where all 34 existing operators will post locked ETH bonds for the first time, adding economic accountability. Liquid-staking protocol Lido deployed its largest upgrade [since 2023's V2](https://www.coindesk.com/tech/2023/05/15/liquid-staking-leader-lido-upgrades-to-second-version-on-ethereum), starting the consolidation of over 8 million staked ether (stETH), worth roughly $16.5 billion, onto Ethereum’s [post-Pectra](https://www.coindesk.com/tech/2025/05/07/ethereum-activates-pectra-upgrade-raising-max-stake-to-2048-eth) validator design introduced a year ago. summary: Title: Live updates: Bitcoin gives up early gains, holds near $65,000 as AI stocks skid URL Source: https://www.coindesk.com/markets/2026/07/27/live-updates-ether-leads-crypto-higher-as-bitcoin-trades-around-usd65-500 Published Time: 2026-07-27T06:43:34.646Z Markdown Content: coverage ended Jul 27, 2026, 9:15 PM CoinEx's Jeff Ko sees bitcoin staying range-bound near $65,000 while retreating oil, a 4.7% 10-year yield and a week of mega-cap earnings set the tone. ![Image 1: Bitcoin (BTC) price on Monday, July 27 (CoinDesk)](https://www.coindesk.com/_next/image?url=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.sanity.io%2Fimages%2Fs3y3vcno%2Fproduction%2F3ab7bae0f5eca3344d78fd14752f64216f38f16a-2130x1186.png%3Fauto%3Dformat&w=1920&q=75) Bitcoin near $65,000 (CoinDesk) ![Image 2: Helene Braun](https://www.coindesk.com/_next/image?url=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.sanity.io%2Fimages%2Fs3y3vcno%2Fproduction%2F4d1961b17d266e7c19bdcc14478d59b99ee0a3fc-944x554.png%3Fw%3D64%26h%3D64%26fit%3Dcrop%26crop%3Dfocalpoint%26auto%3Dformat&w=96&q=75) ## Schwab: Clarity Act odds had little impact on Bitcoin Charles Schwab research found that changes in the perceived odds of the Clarity Act passing explained just 4.3% of bitcoin's (BTC) daily price movements this year, suggesting delays to the legislation may have little immediate impact on the cryptocurrency's price. Still, Jim Feraioli, Charles Schwab's head of crypto research, said the bill's eventual passage remains a key catalyst because it could revive the institutional adoption narrative and provide upside for bitcoin in the short term. His comments come as Senate negotiators released updated text for the CLARITY Act, combining House and Senate proposals into a single draft and introducing language outlining what ethics provisions for public officials could look like. The legislation, however, still faces several steps before it can become law. * * * ![Image 3: Krisztian Sandor](https://www.coindesk.com/_next/image?url=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.sanity.io%2Fimages%
